notes: AMENDMENT to 20261010T203640-986301 (cv 0.8401, 6 features). Not a correction of the arithmetic, which stands, but of what it was taken to mean. (1) The 0.8401 was selected from 36 paired comparisons; six removals were accepted greedily and three of them -- Parch -0.0012, Deck -0.0047, AgeMissing -0.0023 -- COST accuracy and were accepted only because the cost did not reach the 0.003 bar. The six accepted drops sum to exactly +0.00410, the whole reported gain, so the gain is Deck and AgeMissing alone. (2) Compared directly against baseline 20261010T203602-d38cdc on identical folds, the whole move is +0.0043 +/- 0.0041 (0.73 sigma) -- a comparison exp-006 declined to make, not a limit of the data; its 'cannot distinguish the pruned set from the baseline' was answerable by CV all along. (3) Nested CV over 5 outer folds measures the search's selection bias at +0.0105, larger than the gain it bought, and the search generalises 0.0088 +/- 0.0068 WORSE than not searching. (4) DELTA=0.003 is ~1 SE and 1.7 passengers on 569 rows, measured over 10 fold seeds, so each decision was closer to a coin flip than its verdict suggested. The val read 20261010T203704-9773c4 (0.8112) is NOT evidence for any of this: 143 rows resolve ~0.064. See docs/MEASUREMENT.md.
